68:5.wbw: So soon you will see and they will see
68:5.tr: So you will see and they will see

20:41.wbw: And I (have) chosen you for Myself
20:41.tr: And I produced you for Myself.

56:13.wbw: A company of the former people
56:13.tr: A [large] company of the former peoples

37:127.wbw: But they denied him so indeed they (will) surely be brought
37:127.tr: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],

44:21.wbw: And if not you believe me then leave me alone"
44:21.tr: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

26:133.wbw: He has aided you with cattle and children
26:133.tr: Provided you with grazing livestock and children

55:5.wbw: The sun and the moon by (precise) calculation
55:5.tr: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

69:39.tr: And what you do not see

38:38.tr: And others bound together in shackles.

53:12.wbw: Then will you dispute with him about what he saw?
53:12.tr: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

27:53.wbw: And We saved those who believed and used (to) fear (Allah)
27:53.tr: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah.

54:13.wbw: And We carried him on (ark) made of planks (ark) made of planks and nails
54:13.tr: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

37:153.wbw: Has He chosen [the] daughters over sons?
37:153.tr: Has He chosen daughters over sons?

79:30.wbw: And the earth after that He spread it
79:30.tr: And after that He spread the earth.

26:199.ar: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
26:199.wbw: And he (had) recited it to them not they would in it (be) believers
26:199.tr: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.

51:18.wbw: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness
51:18.tr: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

79:37.tr: So as for he who transgressed

43:14.wbw: And indeed we to our Lord will surely return"
43:14.tr: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."

26:205.wbw: Then have you seen if We let them enjoy (for) years
26:205.tr: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years

35:23.tr: You, [O Muhammad], are not but a warner.

26:99.wbw: And not misguided us except the criminals
26:99.tr: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

74:15.wbw: Then he desires that I (should) add more
74:15.tr: Then he desires that I should add more.

81:28.wbw: For whoever wills among you to take a straight way
81:28.tr: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

26:212.wbw: Indeed they from the hearing (are) surely banished
26:212.tr: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.

20:36.wbw: He said "Verily you are granted your request O Musa!
20:36.tr: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.

23:1.tr: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:

40:48.ar: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُلّٞ فِيهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدۡ حَكَمَ بَيۡنَ ٱلۡعِبَادِ
40:48.wbw: Will say those who (were) arrogant "Indeed we all (are) in it Indeed Allah certainly has judged between (His) slaves"
40:48.tr: Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all [of us] are in it. Indeed, Allah has judged between the servants."

53:1.wbw: By the star when it goes down
53:1.tr: By the star when it descends,

104:3.wbw: Thinking that his wealth will make him immortal
104:3.tr: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.

73:1.tr: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],

37:29.wbw: They will say "Nay not you were believers
37:29.tr: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

26:81.wbw: And the One Who will cause me to die then he will give me life
26:81.tr: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

74:33.wbw: And the night when it departs
74:33.tr: And [by] the night when it departs

68:35.wbw: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
68:35.tr: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

68:20.wbw: So it became as if reaped
68:20.tr: And it became as though reaped.

56:76.wbw: And indeed it (is) surely an oath if you know - great
56:76.tr: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.

74:45.wbw: And we used (to) indulge in vain talk with the vain talkers
74:45.tr: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],

69:11.ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ
69:11.wbw: Indeed We when overflowed the water We carried you in the sailing (ship)
69:11.tr: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship

15:99.wbw: And worship your Lord until comes to you the certainty
15:99.tr: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).

56:59.wbw: Is it you who create it or (are) We the Creators?
56:59.tr: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

37:54.tr: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"

19:38.ar: أَسۡمِعۡ بِهِمۡ وَأَبۡصِرۡ يَوۡمَ يَأۡتُونَنَا لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
19:38.wbw: How they will hear! How they will hear! and how (they will) see! (the) Day they will come to Us but the wrongdoers today (are) in error clear
19:38.tr: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.

42:17.ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَٱلۡمِيزَانَۗ وَمَا يُدۡرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٞ
42:17.wbw: Allah (is) the One Who (has) sent down the Book in truth and the Balance And what will make you know? Perhaps the Hour (is) near
42:17.tr: It is Allah who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.

37:12.wbw: Nay you wonder while they mock
37:12.tr: But you wonder, while they mock,

84:14.wbw: Indeed he (had) thought that never he would return
84:14.tr: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].

55:60.wbw: Is (the) reward for the good but good?
55:60.tr: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

43:66.ar: هَلۡ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
43:66.wbw: Are they waiting except (for) the Hour that it should come on them suddenly while they (do) not perceive?
43:66.tr: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?

68:28.ar: قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
68:28.wbw: Said (the) most moderate of them "Did not I tell you Why not you glorify (Allah)
68:28.tr: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]?' "

25:77.ar: قُلۡ مَا يَعۡبَؤُاْ بِكُمۡ رَبِّي لَوۡلَا دُعَآؤُكُمۡۖ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبۡتُمۡ فَسَوۡفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامَۢا
25:77.wbw: Say "Not will care for you my Lord if not your prayer (is to Him) But verily you have denied so soon will be the inevitable (punishment)"
25:77.tr: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.

26:114.wbw: And not I am the one to drive away the believers
26:114.tr: And I am not one to drive away the believers.

79:13.wbw: Then only it (will be) a shout single
79:13.tr: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

80:5.wbw: As for (him) who considers himself free from need
80:5.tr: As for he who thinks himself without need,

102:3.tr: No! You are going to know.

45:8.ar: يَسۡمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَاۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
45:8.wbw: Who hears (the) Verses (of) Allah recited to him then persists arrogantly as if not he heard them So give him tidings (of) a punishment painful
45:8.tr: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

37:151.wbw: No doubt indeed they of their falsehood [they] say
37:151.tr: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,

6:62.ar: ثُمَّ رُدُّوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَوۡلَىٰهُمُ ٱلۡحَقِّۚ أَلَا لَهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ وَهُوَ أَسۡرَعُ ٱلۡحَٰسِبِينَ
6:62.wbw: Then they are returned to Allah their Protector - [the] True Unquestionably for Him (is) the judgment? And He (is) swiftest (in taking) account
6:62.tr: Then they His servants are returned to Allah, their true Lord. Unquestionably, His is the judgement, and He is the swiftest of accountants.

70:15.wbw: By no means! Indeed it (is) surely a Flame of Hell
70:15.tr: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],

53:22.tr: That, then, is an unjust division.

40:69.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصۡرَفُونَ
40:69.wbw: Do not you see [to] those who dispute concerning (the) Signs (of) Allah? How they are turned away?
40:69.tr: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah - how are they averted?

58:2.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِهِمۡۖ إِنۡ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمۡ إِلَّا ٱلَّٰٓـِٔي وَلَدۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَزُورٗاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٞ
58:2.wbw: Those who pronounce zihar among you [from] (to) their wives not they (are) their mothers Not (are) their mothers except those who gave them birth And indeed they surely say an evil [of] [the] word and a lie But indeed Allah (is) surely Oft-Pardoning Oft-Forgiving
58:2.tr: Those who pronounce thihar among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving.

27:28.ar: ٱذۡهَب بِّكِتَٰبِي هَٰذَا فَأَلۡقِهۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
27:28.wbw: Go with my letter this and deliver it to them Then turn away from them and see what they return"
27:28.tr: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."

6:41.ar: بَلۡ إِيَّاهُ تَدۡعُونَ فَيَكۡشِفُ مَا تَدۡعُونَ إِلَيۡهِ إِن شَآءَ وَتَنسَوۡنَ مَا تُشۡرِكُونَ
6:41.wbw: "Nay Him Alone you call and He would remove what you call upon Him if He wills and you will forget what you associate (with Him)"
6:41.tr: No, it is Him [alone] you would invoke, and He would remove that for which you invoked Him if He willed, and you would forget what you associate [with Him].

10:28.ar: وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُهُمۡ جَمِيعٗا ثُمَّ نَقُولُ لِلَّذِينَ أَشۡرَكُواْ مَكَانَكُمۡ أَنتُمۡ وَشُرَكَآؤُكُمۡۚ فَزَيَّلۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ شُرَكَآؤُهُم مَّا كُنتُمۡ إِيَّانَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
10:28.wbw: And (the) Day We will gather them all together then We will say to those who associate partners (with Allah) "(Remain in) your place you and your partners" Then We will separate [between] them and (will) say their partners "Not you used (to) worship us" worship us"
10:28.tr: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will gather them all together - then We will say to those who associated others with Allah, "[Remain in] your place, you and your 'partners.' " Then We will separate them, and their "partners" will say, "You did not used to worship us,

17:23.ar: ۞وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلۡوَٰلِدَيۡنِ إِحۡسَٰنًاۚ إِمَّا يَبۡلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلۡكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوۡ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفّٖ وَلَا تَنۡهَرۡهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوۡلٗا كَرِيمٗا
17:23.wbw: And has decreed your Lord that (do) not worship except Him Alone and to the parents (be) good Whether reach with you the old age one of them or both of them then (do) not say to both of them a word of disrespect and (do) not repel them but speak to them a word noble
17:23.tr: And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him, and to parents, good treatment. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], "uff," and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word.

20:65.ar: قَالُواْ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلۡقِيَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنۡ أَلۡقَىٰ
20:65.wbw: They said "O Musa! Either [that] you throw or [that] we will be the first who throws?"
20:65.tr: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."

40:18.ar: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلۡحَنَاجِرِ كَٰظِمِينَۚ مَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ حَمِيمٖ وَلَا شَفِيعٖ يُطَاعُ
40:18.wbw: And warn them (of the) Day the Approaching when the hearts (are) at the throats choked Not for the wrongdoers any intimate friend and no intercessor (who) is obeyed
40:18.tr: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.

27:10.ar: وَأَلۡقِ عَصَاكَۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنّٞ وَلَّىٰ مُدۡبِرٗا وَلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفۡ إِنِّي لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
27:10.wbw: And Throw your staff" But when he saw it moving as if it (were) a snake he turned back (in) flight and (did) not look back "O Musa! (Do) not fear Indeed [I] (do) not fear (in) My presence the Messengers
27:10.tr: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.

50:23.ar: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ
50:23.wbw: And (will) say his companion "This (is) what (is) with me ready"
50:23.tr: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."

2:81.ar: بَلَىٰۚ مَن كَسَبَ سَيِّئَةٗ وَأَحَٰطَتۡ بِهِۦ خَطِيٓـَٔتُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِۖ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
2:81.wbw: Yes whoever earned evil and surrounded him with his sins [so] those (are the) companions (of) the Fire they in it (will) abide forever
2:81.tr: Yes, whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

75:4.ar: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُۥ
75:4.wbw: Nay! [We are] able on that We can restore his fingertips
75:4.tr: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.

75:10.wbw: Will say [the] man that Day "Where (is) the escape?"
75:10.tr: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

9:40.ar: إِلَّا تَنصُرُوهُ فَقَدۡ نَصَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِذۡ أَخۡرَجَهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ثَانِيَ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ إِذۡ هُمَا فِي ٱلۡغَارِ إِذۡ يَقُولُ لِصَٰحِبِهِۦ لَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَاۖ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَيۡهِ وَأَيَّدَهُۥ بِجُنُودٖ لَّمۡ تَرَوۡهَا وَجَعَلَ كَلِمَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلسُّفۡلَىٰۗ وَكَلِمَةُ ٱللَّهِ هِيَ ٱلۡعُلۡيَاۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ
9:40.wbw: If not you help him certainly Allah helped him Allah helped him when drove him out those who disbelieved the second (of) the two when they both (were) in the cave when he said to his companion "(Do) not grieve indeed Allah (is) with us" Then Allah sent down Then Allah sent down His tranquility upon him and supported him with forces which you did not see which you did not see and made (the) word (of) those who disbelieved the lowest while (the) Word (of) Allah it (is) the highest And Allah (is) All-Mighty All-Wise
9:40.tr: If you do not aid the Prophet - Allah has already aided him when those who disbelieved had driven him out [of Makkah] as one of two, when they were in the cave and he said to his companion, "Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us." And Allah sent down his tranquillity upon him and supported him with angels you did not see and made the word of those who disbelieved the lowest, while the word of Allah - that is the highest. And Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise.

69:27.wbw: O! I wish it had been the end
69:27.tr: I wish my death had been the decisive one.

6:27.ar: وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذۡ وُقِفُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ فَقَالُواْ يَٰلَيۡتَنَا نُرَدُّ وَلَا نُكَذِّبَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّنَا وَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
6:27.wbw: And if you (could) see when they are made to stand by the Fire then they (will) say "Oh! Would that we were sent back and not we would deny (the) Signs (of) our Lord and we would be among the believers"
6:27.tr: If you could but see when they are made to stand before the Fire and will say, "Oh, would that we could be returned [to life on earth] and not deny the signs of our Lord and be among the believers."

20:40.ar: إِذۡ تَمۡشِيٓ أُخۡتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلۡ أَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكۡفُلُهُۥۖ فَرَجَعۡنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَۚ وَقَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسٗا فَنَجَّيۡنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلۡغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونٗاۚ فَلَبِثۡتَ سِنِينَ فِيٓ أَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئۡتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٖ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
20:40.wbw: When was going your sister and she said "Shall I show you [to] (one) who will nurse and rear him'?" So We returned you to your mother that may be cooled her eyes and not she grieves And you killed a man but We saved you from the distress and We tried you (with) a trial Then you remained (some) years with (the) people (of) Madyan Then you came at the decreed (time) O Musa!
20:40.tr: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.

10:48.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
10:48.wbw: And they say "When (will) this the promise (be fulfilled) if you are truthful?"
10:48.tr: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"

7:119.wbw: So they were defeated there and returned humiliated
7:119.tr: And Pharaoh and his people were overcome right there and became debased.

37:56.wbw: He (will) say "By Allah verily you almost ruined me
37:56.tr: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me.

79:42.wbw: They ask you about the Hour when (is) its arrival?
79:42.tr: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?

26:146.wbw: Will you be left in what (is) here secure
26:146.tr: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

81:21.wbw: One to be obeyed and trustworthy
81:21.tr: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

37:18.tr: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

7:132.ar: وَقَالُواْ مَهۡمَا تَأۡتِنَا بِهِۦ مِنۡ ءَايَةٖ لِّتَسۡحَرَنَا بِهَا فَمَا نَحۡنُ لَكَ بِمُؤۡمِنِينَ
7:132.wbw: And they said "Whatever you bring us therewith of (the) sign so that you bewitch us with it then not we (will be) in you believers"
7:132.tr: And they said, "No matter what sign you bring us with which to bewitch us, we will not be believers in you."
